_readme: Copy this file to config.local.json, edit the values, then run: python3 netconfig.py config.local.json --platform mikrotik. Everything below is fill-in-the-blank. VLAN ids must be unique (1-4094). Subnets must be private (RFC-1918) and must not overlap. Gateways and DHCP ranges must sit inside their VLAN subnet. The 'firewall.intent' list is plain English describing who may reach whom; the tool turns it into real firewall rules and then verifies the generated rules actually enforce it.
operator: Ark IT Services / tech: J. Rivera

wan.notes: Fiber ONT hands off DHCP on ether1. If the ISP uses PPPoE or a static IP, edit the WAN section of the generated config before pasting.

lan.trunk_notes: ether2 -> 24-port switch, ether3 -> ceiling AP. Both carry all VLANs tagged.

vlans.name: management
vlans.purpose: Network gear + admin workstation (router, switch, AP, NVR admin)

vlans.name: staff
vlans.purpose: Front-desk and operatory workstations, practice-management PCs

vlans.name: cameras
vlans.purpose: IP cameras + NVR. No internet, isolated from everything except staff viewing.

vlans.name: guest
vlans.purpose: Waiting-room guest Wi-Fi. Internet only, no access to any internal VLAN.

extra_rules.note: Staff view live camera streams (RTSP + NVR web UI) but nothing else on the camera VLAN
